text: At its meeting of June 5, 2018, The Human Resources, Compensation and Labour Relations Committee considered the report (May 30, 2018) Vice President of Operations, Civic Theatres Toronto on Toronto Centre for the Arts – Ratification of IATSE B-173 Collective Agreement

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Approved the collective agreement between IATSE Local B-173 and Civic Theatres Toronto, all as more particularly noted in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 30, 2018) from the Vice President of Operations, Civic Theatres Toronto. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 30, 2018) from the Vice President of Operations, Civic Theatres Toronto remain confidential as it pertains to the security of the property of the municipality or local board.
